name: MSE 5097
title: Research Methods in Materials Science and Engineering
description: Introduction to modern methodologies of experimental or computational materials research. A maximum of three credits can count toward the MSE graduate course credit requirements for M.S. Plan B or M.Eng. degrees. Cannot substitute for any GRAD course or be used to satisfy M.S. or Ph.D. degree credit requirements for thesis or dissertation research.
requirement_description: Open to M.S. Plan B or M.Eng. students; major advisor approval required.
